description: This file contains business logic for cart and order operations within a Django e-commerce application, including functions to add, remove, and update cart items.

classes.name: CartResult
classes.description: Data class representing the result of a cart operation, including a message, redirect name, and optional redirect parameters.

methods.name: CartResult add_item_to_cart(*, user: get_user_model(), item: Item)
methods.description: Adds an item to the user's active cart, creating an order if none exists, or updating quantities if the item is already in the cart.

methods.name: CartResult remove_item_from_cart(*, user: get_user_model(), item: Item)
methods.description: Removes an item entirely from the user's active cart.

methods.name: CartResult remove_single_quantity_from_cart(*, user: get_user_model(), item: Item)
methods.description: Decreases the quantity of an item in the cart by one, removing the item if quantity reaches zero.

ctags.name: add_item_to_cart
ctags.pattern: /^def add_item_to_cart(*, user: get_user_model(), item: Item) -> CartResult:$/

ctags.name: remove_item_from_cart
ctags.pattern: /^def remove_item_from_cart(*, user: get_user_model(), item: Item) -> CartResult:$/

ctags.name: remove_single_quantity_from_cart
ctags.pattern: /^def remove_single_quantity_from_cart(*, user: get_user_model(), item: Item) -> CartResult:$/
